mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_token_usage ( trace_id, session_id, user_id, model_name, scenario, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms, success, error_message, input_snippet, output_snippet, called_at ) VALUES ( #{traceId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{modelName}, #{scenario}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{costUsd}, #{durationMs}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{inputSnippet}, #{outputSnippet}, COALESCE(#{calledAt}, NOW()) )
mapper.select: SELECT model_name AS "modelName", SUM(input_tokens) AS "inputTokens", SUM(output_tokens) AS "outputTokens", SUM(cost_usd) AS "costUsd" FROM llm_token_usage WHERE called_at >= #{since} GROUP BY model_name

SELECT COALESCE(t.user_id, 'anonymous') AS "userId", COALESCE(u.username, CASE WHEN t.user_id IS NULL THEN 'anonymous' ELSE t.user_id END) AS "username", u.nickname AS "nickname", SUM(t.total_tokens) AS "totalTokens", SUM(t.cost_usd) AS "costUsd" FROM llm_token_usage t LEFT JOIN biz_user_account u ON u.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.called_at >= #{since} GROUP BY t.user_id, u.username, u.nickname ORDER BY SUM(t.cost_usd) DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "callCount", COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS "inputTokens", COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS "outputTokens", COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS "totalTokens", COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS "costUsd", MAX(called_at) AS "lastCalledAt" FROM llm_token_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND called_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_token_usage WHERE success = false AND called_at >= #{since}

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', called_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::DATE AS "day", SUM(cost_usd) AS "costUsd", SUM(total_tokens) AS "totalTokens" FROM llm_token_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND called_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', called_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::DATE ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', called_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::DATE AS "day", SUM(cost_usd) AS "costUsd", SUM(total_tokens) AS "totalTokens" FROM llm_token_usage WHERE called_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', called_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::DATE ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT id AS "id", trace_id AS "traceId", session_id AS "sessionId", model_name AS "modelName", scenario AS "scenario", input_tokens AS "inputTokens", output_tokens AS "outputTokens", total_tokens AS "totalTokens", cost_usd AS "costUsd", duration_ms AS "durationMs", success AS "success", error_message AS "errorMessage", input_snippet AS "inputSnippet", output_snippet AS "outputSnippet", called_at AS "calledAt" FROM llm_token_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND called_at >= #{since} ORDER BY called_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success = false) AS "errors" FROM llm_token_usage WHERE called_at >= #{since}
